feature: ORDER BY / LIMIT on a labelled type-scan graph envelope (the 'latest emission of kind X' panel shape)

scenarios.name: latest emission by data field — LIMIT 1
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-skip-limit (LIMIT 1 latest by field)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) WHERE n.data.severity_score > 0 ORDER BY n.data.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

scenarios.name: top-N DESC envelope returns the N highest by data field
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) WHERE n.data.severity_score > 0 ORDER BY n.data.observed_at DESC LIMIT 3

scenarios.name: tied ORDER BY keys broken by entity_id ascending — LIMIT 1 picks the lower id
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-orderby (tie-break determinism on equal keys)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) WHERE n.data.severity_score = 30 ORDER BY n.data.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

scenarios.name: NULL data-lane field sorts last under ASC (Postgres native NULLS LAST)
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-orderby (NULL ordering under ASC)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) ORDER BY n.data.observed_at ASC LIMIT 1

scenarios.name: NULL data-lane field sorts first under DESC (Postgres native NULLS FIRST)
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-orderby (NULL ordering under DESC)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) ORDER BY n.data.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

scenarios.name: ORDER BY a spine field (n.name) descending
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-orderby (order by a spine field descending)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) ORDER BY n.name DESC LIMIT 1

scenarios.name: RETURN omitted form equivalent to RETURN n — both accept envelope ORDER BY
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-orderby (ORDER BY independent of RETURN projection)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) WHERE n.data.severity_score > 0 RETURN n ORDER BY n.data.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

scenarios.name: LIMIT zero returns an empty envelope
oversize LIMIT returns every matching node
ORDER BY with no LIMIT compiles correctly (witness via SQL)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) WHERE n.data.severity_score > 0 ORDER BY n.data.observed_at DESC

scenarios.name: multi-key envelope ORDER BY orders left-to-right with mixed directions
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) ORDER BY n.data.severity_score ASC, n.data.observed_at DESC LIMIT 3

scenarios.name: ORDER BY with no direction token defaults to ascending
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-orderby (ORDER BY with no ASC/DESC defaults to ascending)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) WHERE n.data.severity_score > 0 ORDER BY n.data.severity_score

scenarios.name: ORDER BY a RETURN alias orders rows by the projected alias
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-orderby (ORDER BY references a RETURN projection alias)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:gryphon_playground__pg_node) RETURN n.data.severity_score AS sev ORDER BY sev
